orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The request to plan a procurement that includes supplies, services, and works exceeds the scope of the procurement office. Consultation with services specialist revealed that only services fit within its mandate, but with a significant restriction. The services specialist declined the request for supplies and works due to being out-of-scope. The supplies specialist did propose breaking large requirements into lots below the EU threshold, but failed to fully rectify the sustainability criterion enforcement rule; despite the proposed lots adhering to the correct total share on the annual budget, shares per lot may exceed the maximum allowed EU threshold of 221,000 € for 'Lot 1' which must be reviewed. Based on these results, we recommend proceeding with the procurement of services only, with works and supplies being outside our mandates. The recommended allocation is based on the services proposal only. Note that these allocations will need to accommodate the violation of shares on 'Lot 1'. We require explicit attention on the sustainability criteria and the division of 'Lot 1' due to the violation of the works threshold in the current proposal; this requires a re-evaluation of the works procurement. The award criterion for the services contract will be a best price-quality ratio with a weight of 40% for price and 60% for quality. Due to the violation of some rules, the proposed services contract for 60% of the budget falls below the annual threshold for a single contract for the services, making the share per year below the allowed share of the 2027 budget for the works contract. An explicit statement that the share must accommodate these discrepancies is part of the request. An explicit attention warning for 'Lot 1' needs to be part of the contract due to the violation of the maximum contracted lot value.
